parsed.explanation: Claim 3.2 validly handles only finite minimal transversals, since π(T) is defined only then. The existence of a finite transversal does not imply all minimal transversals are finite: for example, the family {{z,x_n}: n≥1} has the infinite minimal transversal {x_n:n≥1}. Step 4 applies self-duality to a Zorn-produced transversal inside the infinite set I∪Z_ω and obtains its finiteness only from the disputed claim, so the reasoning is circular. No other passage proves the required finiteness of the relevant primes/minimal elements for all cases; repairing this requires a substantive lemma or replacement argument.
